title: 5e-2: health scoring with category capping
description:
## Parent

sutra/83 (5e PRD: health metrics + similarity system)

## What to build

Score derivation from health findings using repowise's category-capping pattern. Base score 10.0, deductions per finding (severity_weight × biomarker_weight), capped per category (organizational -3.5, structural -2.5, coupling -2.0, freshness -1.5, coverage -2.0). Proportional scaling within capped categories preserves per-finding attribution. Per-file scores derived from findings. Component-level scores as NLOC-weighted averages. Rewrite the existing file_health MCP tool to use the new finding-based model.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] health/scoring module: category capping with proportional scaling when a category exceeds its cap
- [ ] Per-file health score (1.0-10.0) derived from all findings targeting that file
- [ ] Per-component health score as NLOC-weighted average of member file scores
- [ ] Repowise calibrated weights as defaults for shared biomarkers
- [ ] file_health MCP tool rewritten to return findings + derived score (not the old hardcoded sub-scores)
- [ ] Tests: proportional scaling correctness, category cap enforcement, component aggregation, edge cases (no findings = 10.0, all categories maxed = 1.0)

## Blocked by

- sutra/84 (5e-1: health finding model)"
